newsitem.title: USA: Nicollet Process Engineering hires advisor.
newsitem.headline: Nicollet Process Engineering hires advisor.

text.p: Nicollet Process Engineering Inc said Thursday it has hired Tiger Financial Group LLC as a strategic advisor and investor relations counsel.
Last week, Nicollet reported a loss of $0.14 in the second quarter ended February 28 versus a loss of $0.19 a year ago, with gross margin improving to 33 percent from 13 percent.
Tiger Financial said the market value of the company's stock does not reflect the value of the company in light of its growth prospects over the near- and long-term.
Nicollet designs and makes process monitoring, control and server-based distributed computing systems.
Its shares closed down 1/4 Thursday at 3/4.
